What if Kirby inhaled the Radiance?

Kirby floats into Hallownest and inhales the first Husk he sees, gaining a tiny nail and a tiny cloak. Then he swallows the Radiance whole and becomes a glowing light god with the same happy pink smile. Is Kirby the true final boss of every game, or does the Void finally stop him?
